rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a hatching/hatched day-5 4BB blastocyst with loosely grouped ICM and loose TE, consistent with the provided Gardner score; minor overinterpretation of viability from hatching behavior.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, uterine factor, prior IVF outcome, sperm parameters, and endometrium well, though some links to embryo quality are somewhat speculative.

Overall structured and logical, but several deductions are additive/speculative, and claims such as expecting a 4AA/4AB at age 32 or attributing BB grade to occult gamete issues are not well supported.

Generally aligned on eSET, alcohol cessation, and uterine evaluation, but includes weaker or non-routine suggestions such as ERA after only one failed cycle and overstates some evidence around morphology and prognosis.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer, luteal support considerations, lifestyle modification, and future workup; some suggestions are more aggressive than standard for this history.
